items.s: our weather radar has failed and we are in i m c request return for landing

items.s: our weather radar has malfunctioned what is the highest available level for cruise

items.s: we do not have that runway in our database request delay our descent while we program the c d u

items.s: we have a navigation malfunction request diversion to a suitable airport that has less complex terrain

items.s: the n o t a m says the i l s is unserviceable but we are still picking up the morse code confirm it is still in operation

items.s: many passengers have suffered from smoke inhalation request medical services

items.s: there was heavy smoke in the cabin before we ventilated the aircraft request medical assistance for passengers after landing

items.s: the aircraft is depressurized we are descending confirm 10,000 feet is enough to clear terrain until we reach our alternate

items.s: we are no longer getting bleed air from the right engine request immediate descent to leave the icing area

items.s: we are expediting descent to enable a windmill startup request further descent

items.s: both engine bleed air systems have failed and we are relying on a p u bleed for air conditioning request descent to 14 000 feet

items.s: we have no bleed air coming from either engines or a p u request rapid descent to 10,000feet

items.s: c p d l c has malfunctioned we are reverting to voice communication

items.s: we just had an a p u fire warning and discharged the fire extinguisher request visual check if there is smoke coming from our tail section

items.s: another aircraft has seen a lot of smoke coming from our a p u we are evacuating request emergency services

items.s: we are at bay15 we have an a p u fire request fire services

items.s: we have a generator failure and cannot start our a p u at this altitude request descent to perform a p u startup

items.s: a passenger tried to unlock the cabin door in flight the cabin crew restrained him request airport police on arrival

items.s: we have an abnormal noise coming from one of our cabin doors request rapid descent to 5000 feet

items.s: smoke is coming from the cabin floor we are performing an evacuation all slides have been deployed

items.s: we had a smoke warning from the forward cargo hold we are evacuating

items.s: the windshield is cracked on the outside request descent

items.s: the number two engine has been shut down we are no longer able to maintain level flight.request descent to flight level 200

items.en: I apologize for the level bust, but we needed the altitude loss to recover from wind-shear.
items.cn: 很抱歉偏离指定高度，但我们需要损失高度来改出风切变。
items.s: i apologize for the level bust but we needed the altitude loss to recover from wind shear

items.en: We encountered heavy rain and had a temporary flame out on our right engine. Request immediate climb.
items.cn: 我们遇到了大雨，右发暂时熄火，请示立即上升。
items.s: we encountered heavy rain and had a temporary flame out on our right engine request immediate climb

items.en: We won't have to deviate if you allow us to climb to FL430.
items.cn: 如允许我们上升到高度层430，我们就不用偏置了。
items.s: we won't have to deviate if you allow us to climb to flight level 430

items.en: The thunderstorms will last for about 40 minutes according to the weather update. Request diversion.
items.cn: 根据天气更新情况，雷暴将持续约40分钟。请示备降。
items.s: the thunderstorms will last for about 40 minutes according to the weather update request diversion

items.en: We have encountered severe clear air turbulence. Request immediate descent.
items.cn: 我们已遭受严重晴空颠簸，请示立即下降。
items.s: we have encountered severe clear air turbulence request immediate descent

items.en: Request a general heading of 050 due to multiple cells ahead.
items.cn: 前方多个单体雷雨区，请示飞航向大约050.
items.s: request a general heading of 050 due to multiple cells ahead

items.en: We have stopped on Runway 23 and will remain on the runway due heavy fog. I say again, we are still on the runway.
items.cn: 我们停在了23号跑道上，并且由于浓雾我们仍在跑道上。再说一遍，我们仍在跑道上。
items.s: we have stopped on runway 23 and will remain on the runway due heavy fog i say again we are still on the runway

items.en: There is heavy drifting fog. We think it is no longer safe to taxi. Request to hold at present position.
items.cn: 有较大平流雾，我们认为对滑行不安全，请示原地等待。
items.s: there is heavy drifting fog we think it is no longer safe to taxi request to hold at present position

items.en: Frontal weather is quickly moving in from the west. If the holding is more than 10 minutes, we will have to divert.
items.cn: 锋面天气很快由西移动过来。如果等待超过10分钟，我们就必须要备降。
items.s: frontal weather is quickly moving in from the west if the holding is more than 10 minutes we will have to divert

items.en: We made the go-around because strong convective currents on short final made our approach unstable.
items.cn: 我们复飞的原因是因为短五边很强的对流使进近不稳定。
items.s: we made the go around because strong convective currents on short final made our approach unstable

items.en: There was temperature inversion when we descended through 3000 feet. Our airspeed dropped suddenly by 25 knots.
items.cn: 我们下降通过3000英尺时有逆温层。我们的空速突然掉了25节。
items.s: there was temperature inversion when we descended through 3000 feet our airspeed dropped suddenly by 25 knots

items.en: We performed the missed approach below the minimum because of advection fog. We could no longer see the runway lights.
items.cn: 由于平流雾，我们执行了低于最低高度的复飞。我们不能再看见跑道灯了。
items.s: we performed the missed approach below the minimum because of advection fog we could no longer see the runway lights

items.en: The latest weather says that frontal weather and freezing rain is now stationary over the airport. Request diversion.
items.cn: 最新气象报说锋面天气和冻雨正在机场上空停留。请示备降。
items.s: the latest weather says that frontal weather and freezing rain is now stationary over the airport request diversion

items.en: We can't find any gaps for at least 100 miles in the squall line covering our arrival route.Request diversion.
items.cn: 飑线覆盖了我们进场航路，至少100海里范围内我们都找不到任何空间穿越。请示备降。
items.s: we can't find any gaps for at least 100 miles in the squall line covering our arrival route.request diversion

items.en: We can see dust swirls approaching the airport and we're concerned about low level wind-shear. Request holding.
items.cn: 我们能看到尘埃涡流接近机场，我们担心低空风切变。请示等待。
items.s: we can see dust swirls approaching the airport and we're concerned about low level wind shear request holding

items.en: The latest SIGMET says a super-cell thunderstorm is developing at our destination. Is our flight affected?
items.cn: 最新重要气象报表明超级单体雷暴正在我们目的地机场形成。我们的航班受影响吗？
items.s: the latest sigmet says a super cell thunderstorm is developing at our destination is our flight affected

items.en: Request to continue our flight. Our ETA is in two hours and maybe the airport will have the runways cleared of snow by then.
items.cn: 请示继续飞行。我们的预达时刻是2小时后，可能机场会在那时将跑道上的雪除干净。
items.s: request to continue our flight our e t a is in two hours and maybe the airport will have the runways cleared of snow by then

items.en: We had to make a quick heading change due ice pellets. You didn't answer our request so we squawked 7700 and made the heading change.
items.cn: 我们因为冰丸必须快速改变航向。你没有回答我们的申请，因此我们设置应答机编码7700，并改变了航向。
items.s: we had to make a quick heading change due ice pellets you didn't answer our request so we squawked 7700 and made the heading change

items.en: We were struck by hail. Our airframe is severely damaged. Request emergency services.
items.cn: 我们被冰雹击中了。我们的机体严重受损。请示紧急服务。
items.s: we were struck by hail our airframe is severely damaged request emergency services

items.en: We have just encountered a lightning strike. Some of our instruments have erroneous indications. Request diversion to the nearest suitable airport.
items.cn: 我们刚遭受雷击。一些仪表出现错误指示，请示备降到最近的合适机场。
items.s: we have just encountered a lightning strike some of our instruments have erroneous indications request diversion to the nearest suitable airport

items.en: We have had a lightning strike. So far no system seems to be affected. We will continue to our destination.
items.cn: 我们已遭遇雷击，目前为止没有系统受到影响，我们将继续前往目的地。
items.s: we have had a lightning strike so far no system seems to be affected we will continue to our destination

items.en: Roger heavy rain. Request to terminate our approach.
items.cn: 明白，大雨。请示终止进近。
items.s: roger heavy rain request to terminate our approach

items.en: Request to cancel our approach. The runway is not long enough and there are water patches.
items.cn: 请示取消进近。跑道长度不够，还有部分积水。
items.s: request to cancel our approach the runway is not long enough and there are water patches

items.en: Request to cancel our approach. Braking action is poor and we're concerned about hydroplaning during rollout.
items.cn: 请示取消进近。刹车效应差，我们担心滑跑时出现滑水现象。
items.s: request to cancel our approach braking action is poor and we're concerned about hydroplaning during rollout

items.en: Request holding instructions. We'll attempt another approach when the rain showers become lighter.
items.cn: 请示等待指令。阵雨变小的时候，我们将重新进近。
items.s: request holding instructions we'll attempt another approach when the rain showers become lighter

items.en: We have received reports of freezing rain ranging from ground up to 5000 feet. Request diversion.
items.cn: 我们收到了冻雨报告，范围从地面到5000英尺。请示备降。
items.s: we have received reports of freezing rain ranging from ground up to 5000 feet request diversion

items.en: We have observed blowing sand in the vicinity of the airport. How long will this last?
items.cn: 我们已观察到在机场附近有吹沙。持续多长时间呢？
items.s: we have observed blowing sand in the vicinity of the airport how long will this last

items.en: A sandstorm is forecast to reach the airport within 20 minutes. We won't get airborne by then. Request cancel startup and tow back to the gate.
items.cn: 预计沙暴在20分钟内到达机场。我们到那时还不能升空，请示取消开车并拖回停机位。
items.s: a sandstorm is forecast to reach the airport within 20 minutes we won't get airborne by then request cancel startup and tow back to the gate

items.en: Heavy blowing snow is expected to last for another 30 minutes. Request to terminate approach and holding instructions.
items.cn: 较大得到吹雪预计持续30分钟，请示终止进近、等待指令。
items.s: heavy blowing snow is expected to last for another 30 minutes request to terminate approach and holding instructions

items.en: Runway is covered with patches of ice. Braking action is medium to poor.
items.cn: 跑道被大片结冰覆盖，刹车效应中等偏差。
items.s: runway is covered with patches of ice braking action is medium to poor

items.en: Ice patches are covering the runway mostly along the runway edge. Uncontaminated runway width is about 30 meters.
items.cn: 成片结冰覆盖跑道边缘大部分地方。未污染跑道的宽度约30米。
items.s: ice patches are covering the runway mostly along the runway edge uncontaminated runway width is about 30 meters

items.en: A dissipating thunderstorm is ahead of us. We are near the zero-degree isotherm. Request deviate an additional 10 miles to the right.
items.cn: 消散雷暴在我们前方。我们接近零度等温线，请示再右偏10海里。
items.s: a dissipating thunderstorm is ahead of us we are near the zero degree isotherm request deviate an additional 10 miles to the right

items.en: We have a visual on a tornado at our 10 o'clock, about 2 miles. Request immediate right turn.
items.cn: 我们在10点钟方向、大约2海里处目视龙卷风。请示立即右转。
items.s: we have a visual on a tornado at our 10 o'clock about 2 miles request immediate right turn

items.en: The weather forecast says that the typhoon along our route will be intensifying. Request change our airway clearance.
items.cn: 天气预报说我们航路的台风将会增强，请示改变我们的航路许可。
items.s: the weather forecast says that the typhoon along our route will be intensifying request change our airway clearance

items.en: The hurricane has gathered in strength and will affect all airports at the south coast. Request diversion.
items.cn: 飓风已大量聚集，而且将影响南海岸的全部机场。请示备降。
items.s: the hurricane has gathered in strength and will affect all airports at the south coast request diversion

items.en: A Pilot overflying reported seeing virga above the runways. Request to terminate our approach.
items.cn: 一名飞越的飞行员报告在跑道上空看见了雨幡。请示终止进近。
items.s: a pilot overflying reported seeing virga above the runways request to terminate our approach

items.en: Request immediate one eighty turn to the right due volcanic ash.
items.cn: 由于火山灰，请示立即180度右转。
items.s: request immediate one eighty turn to the right due volcanic ash

items.en: We have entered volcanic ash. Our radios and engines are not working properly, now heading 235, and descending to FL 220, squawking 7700.
items.cn: 我们已经进入火山灰。无线电和发动机都不能正常工作，当前航向235，下降到高度层220过程中，应答机编码7700。
items.s: we have entered volcanic ash our radios and engines are not working properly now heading 235 and descending to flight level 220 squawking 7700

items.en: We are landing into the sun in heavy haze. Can you turn on the approach lights to maximum intensity?
items.cn: 我们在严重霾中迎太阳着陆。能把进近灯调到最大强度吗？
items.s: we are landing into the sun in heavy haze can you turn on the approach lights to maximum intensity

items.en: Lining up Runway 35. Runway lights are too bright. Request to dim the runway lights.
items.cn: 对正跑道35中。跑道灯太亮，请示调暗跑道灯。
items.s: lining up runway 35 runway lights are too bright request to dim the runway lights

items.en: There are red lights ahead of us. Confirm taxi instructions.
items.cn: 前方有红灯，证实滑行指令。
items.s: there are red lights ahead of us confirm taxi instructions

items.en: There is an obstruction ahead. Confirm taxi instructions.
items.cn: 前方有障碍物，证实滑行指令。
items.s: there is an obstruction ahead confirm taxi instructions

items.en: The NOTAM says this part of the taxiway is closed during this period, please verify.
items.cn: 航行通告说部分滑行道在这期间关闭，请核实。
items.s: the n o t a m says this part of the taxiway is closed during this period please verify

items.en: The follow-me vehicle is leading us to taxiway L3. Our wings will not clear the otherairplanes on this narrow taxiway. We are stopping.
items.cn: 引导车正引导我们到滑行到L3.在这条较窄的滑行道上我们的机翼无法避开其他飞机。我们停止滑行了。
items.s: the follow me vehicle is leading us to taxiway l3 our wings will not clear the otherairplanes on this narrow taxiway we are stopping

items.en: We are stopping. The ground marshaller is still guiding us in, but I think my engine will hit the boarding bridge if we taxi any further.
items.cn: 我们停止了。地面引导员仍引导我们滑入，但我认为如果我们再滑入，我们的发动机将碰到廊桥。
items.s: we are stopping the ground marshaller is still guiding us in but i think my engine will hit the boarding bridge if we taxi any further

items.en: We are stopping taxi. The boarding bridge is not at its designated position.
items.cn: 我们停止滑行了。廊桥不在指定位置。
items.s: we are stopping taxi the boarding bridge is not at its designated position

items.en: We are shutting down our engines. There are boxes blown by the wind toward our aircraft.
items.cn: 我们正关车。风朝我们飞机方向吹来了一些盒子。
items.s: we are shutting down our engines there are boxes blown by the wind toward our aircraft

items.en: We had difficulty starting up our engines due strong tailwind. Request to change our pushback position facing west.
items.cn: 由于强顺风，我们启动发动机困难。请示改变推出位置，面朝西。
items.s: we had difficulty starting up our engines due strong tailwind request to change our pushback position facing west

items.en: Another aircraft has collided with us. I'll command an evacuation as soon as we both turn off our engines.
items.cn: 另一架飞机与我们相撞。在我们双方都关车后，我将下指令尽快撤离。
items.s: another aircraft has collided with us i'll command an evacuation as soon as we both turn off our engines

items.en: The tow bar has been bent. Our maintenance crew will inspect our nose wheel. Holding position.
items.cn: 拖杆弯了。我们的机务人员将检查前轮。原地等待。
items.s: the tow bar has been bent our maintenance crew will inspect our nose wheel holding position

items.en: The tug has swung around and collided with our forward fuselage. We are shutting down engines. Request stairs vehicle and shuttle bus.
items.cn: 拖车偏转撞到飞机前身。我们正关车。请示客梯车和摆渡车。
items.s: the tug has swung around and collided with our forward fuselage we are shutting down engines request stairs vehicle and shuttle bus

items.en: A catering truck collided with our aft fuselage. There are fumes in the cabin and we are quickly disembarking all passengers. Request fire services.
items.cn: 餐车撞到了我们的后机身。客舱有烟雾，我们正在尽快让所有乘客下机。请示消防服务。
items.s: a catering truck collided with our aft fuselage there are fumes in the cabin and we are quickly disembarking all passengers request fire services

items.en: The flaps were extended inadvertently and hit the fuel truck. We are disembarking all onboard personnel. Request fire services.
items.cn: 襟翼无意中被放出，碰到了油车。我们正在撤离机上所有人员。请示消防服务。
items.s: the flaps were extended inadvertently and hit the fuel truck we are disembarking all onboard personnel request fire services

items.en: Our airplane nose has now lifted off the ground due to improper load and balance. Request ground maintenance.
items.cn: 由于不正确的配载平衡，飞机机头已经翘起，请示地面维护。
items.s: our airplane nose has now lifted off the ground due to improper load and balance request ground maintenance

items.en: We have discovered leakage of dangerous goods in the cargo hold. Can you alert hazardous material specialists?
items.cn: 我们已发现货舱里的危险品泄露。你们能通知危险品专家吗？
items.s: we have discovered leakage of dangerous goods in the cargo hold can you alert hazardous material specialists

items.en: Our cabin crew will direct all passengers to stay outside the runway after evacuation.
items.cn: 撤离后我们的客舱机组将指导所有乘客待在跑道外。
items.s: our cabin crew will direct all passengers to stay outside the runway after evacuation

items.en: The outer main landing gear might have rolled over runway lights when we made the one eighty turn. Request personnel to inspect.
items.cn: 我们180度转弯时主起落架可能擦到了跑道灯。请示人员检查。
items.s: the outer main landing gear might have rolled over runway lights when we made the one eighty turn request personnel to inspect

items.en: We have a suspicious bag on board. Request bomb squad.
items.cn: 机上有可疑的包，请示拆弹小组。
items.s: we have a suspicious bag on board request bomb squad

items.en: The passengers are evacuating. The bomb is still on board.
items.cn: 乘客正在撤离。炸弹还在飞机上。
items.s: the passengers are evacuating the bomb is still on board

items.en: A passenger has assembled a bomb in the lavatory. He is making threats. Request emergency services.
items.cn: 一名乘客已在厕所安装了一枚炸弹。他正在威胁我们，请示紧急服务。
items.s: a passenger has assembled a bomb in the lavatory he is making threats request emergency services

items.en: Request a remote apron for parking our aircraft due bomb on board.
items.cn: 机上有炸弹，请示远机坪停机位。
items.s: request a remote apron for parking our aircraft due bomb on board

items.en: We have had a tail strike. Request to stop climb at 3000 feet and return for landing.
items.cn: 我们已经机尾擦地，请示爬升至3000英尺返场着陆。
items.s: we have had a tail strike request to stop climb at 3000 feet and return for landing

items.en: We have veered off the runway due asymmetric thrust. We are evacuating. Request emergency assistance.
items.cn: 由于不对称推力，我们在跑道上突然转向偏出了跑道，现在正在撤离。请示紧急救助。
items.s: we have veered off the runway due asymmetric thrust we are evacuating request emergency assistance

items.en: We cannot get good climb profile due engine problems. Request maintain runway heading.
items.cn: 由于发动机问题，我们不能得到很好的爬升性能。请示保持跑道方向航向。
items.s: we cannot get good climb profile due engine problems request maintain runway heading

items.en: We made a very hard landing. We'll need maintenance inspection before our next flight.Suggest you check the runway touchdown zone.
items.cn: 我们重着陆了，下次飞行前我们需要机务检查。建议你们检查跑道接地区。
items.s: we made a very hard landing we'll need maintenance inspection before our next flight.suggest you check the runway touchdown zone

items.en: The center of gravity is disturbed. We will relocate passengers prior to approach. Request holding.
items.cn: 重心位置有变，进近千我们需要重新安排乘客。请示等待。
items.s: the center of gravity is disturbed we will relocate passengers prior to approach request holding

items.en: Request a large airspace to maneuver due flight control problems.
items.cn: 由于飞行操纵问题，请示较大空域做机动。
items.s: request a large airspace to maneuver due flight control problems

items.en: My apologies for the deviation due the wrong altitude setting. Request further instructions.
items.cn: 抱歉由于高度表设置错误出现偏差，请示进一步指令。
items.s: my apologies for the deviation due the wrong altitude setting request further instructions

items.en: My apologies for the level deviation. We were caught in a strong updraft.
items.cn: 抱歉高度偏离了，我们遇到了强上升气流。
items.s: my apologies for the level deviation we were caught in a strong updraft

items.en: We used too much speed brakes and penetrated our level. Did we cause any conflict?
items.cn: 我们使用了过量的减速板，穿过了我们的高度层。我们引起冲突了吗？
items.s: we used too much speed brakes and penetrated our level did we cause any conflict

items.en: We were not informed of a frequency change. I will now monitor your frequency.
items.cn: 我们未得到频率改变的通知。我现在马上监听。
items.s: we were not informed of a frequency change i will now monitor your frequency

items.en: Unable visual approach due company policy. Request radar vectors.
items.cn: 公司政策原因不能目视进近。请示雷达引导。
items.s: unable visual approach due company policy request radar vectors

items.en: Unable circling approach due company policy. Request diversion.
items.cn: 公司政策原因不能盘旋进近。请示备降。
items.s: unable circling approach due company policy request diversion

items.en: Are we being vectored too close to the parallel aircraft?
items.cn: 我们引导得是否太靠近平行飞机了？
items.s: are we being vectored too close to the parallel aircraft

items.en: Is the preceding aircraft crossing our altitude?
items.cn: 前机正在穿越我们的高度吗？
items.s: is the preceding aircraft crossing our altitude

items.en: I can read you, but I'm not sure you can hear me. I will squawk ident to comply with your instructions.
items.cn: 我能听到你，但我不确认你能听到我。我将应答机识别来遵守指令。
items.s: i can read you but i'm not sure you can hear me i will squawk ident to comply with your instructions

items.en: I see wildfire at my 10 o'clock, about 8 miles.
items.cn: 我在10点钟方向、大约8海里处看到了野火。
items.s: i see wildfire at my 10 o'clock about 8 miles

items.en: I have heard an aircraft in distress but no one's responding. I can help relay his message.
items.cn: 我听到有飞机遇险了，但没人回应。我能帮助转报信息。
items.s: i have heard an aircraft in distress but no ones responding i can help relay his message

items.en: Message relay: The aircraft in distress will ditch in the ocean. His present coordinate is One Eight Degrees, One Five Minutes, North, One Six Zero Degrees, Five Two Minutes East.
items.cn: 转报：遇险飞机将海上迫降。目前坐标是18度15分北，160度52分东。
items.s: message relay the aircraft in distress will ditch in the ocean his present coordinate is one eight degrees one five minutes north one six zero degrees five two minutes east

items.en: The aircraft in distress says he will attempt to force land in an area about ten miles Northeast of his position.
items.cn: 遇险飞机说他将尝试在其位置东北10海里区域迫降。
items.s: the aircraft in distress says he will attempt to force land in an area about ten miles northeast of his position

items.en: Request offset 10 miles left to avoid the reported strong downdraft.
items.cn: 请示左偏10海里，避开已报告的强下降气流。
items.s: request offset 10 miles left to avoid the reported strong downdraft

items.en: Request diversion. The latest weather at our destination suggests snow storm will last for 5hours.
items.cn: 请示备降。目的地机场最新天气表明雪暴将持续5小时。
items.s: request diversion the latest weather at our destination suggests snow storm will last for 5hours

items.en: Our radar shows a strong echo from the thunderstorm ahead. Request immediate right turn to avoid it.
items.cn: 雷达显示前方强雷暴回波。请示立即右转避开。
items.s: our radar shows a strong echo from the thunderstorm ahead request immediate right turn to avoid it

items.en: Request immediate one-eighty turn to the right due to possible hail ahead.
items.cn: 请示立即180度右转，避开前方冰雹。
items.s: request immediate one eighty turn to the right due to possible hail ahead

items.en: We have three serious and five minor injuries on board. Request ambulances on arrival.
items.cn: 我们机上有三人重伤，五人轻伤。请示救护车到场。
items.s: we have three serious and five minor injuries on board request ambulances on arrival

items.en: One passenger is having difficulty breathing. Request descent to a lower level to reduce cabin altitude.
items.cn: 一名旅客呼吸困难，请示下降到较低高度以减小客舱高度。
items.s: one passenger is having difficulty breathing request descent to a lower level to reduce cabin altitude

items.en: A passenger activated the overhead emergency oxygen generator. Request airport security on arrival to detain this individual.
items.cn: 一名旅客触发了顶部紧急氧气发生器。请示机场保安到场拘留他。
items.s: a passenger activated the overhead emergency oxygen generator request airport security on arrival to detain this individual

items.en: A stressed passenger attempted to open an emergency exit. Request airport security on arrival.
items.cn: 一名闹情绪的旅客试图打开应急出口。请示机场保安到场。
items.s: a stressed passenger attempted to open an emergency exit request airport security on arrival

items.en: We have a hostage situation. Request stair vehicles on standby to disembark the passengers.
items.cn: 我们有一个人质。请示客梯车待命以便让旅客下机。
items.s: we have a hostage situation request stair vehicles on standby to disembark the passengers

items.en: We have a passenger with severe hyperventilation. He has received first aid but his condition is not improving. Request ambulance on arrival.
items.cn: 有一个旅客有严重的过度换气症。他得到了急救但情况没有好转。请示救护车到场。
items.s: we have a passenger with severe hyperventilation he has received first aid but his condition is not improving request ambulance on arrival

items.en: We have a passenger with a suspected heart attack. Request diversion to a suitable airport.
items.cn: 有名旅客疑似有心脏病。请示备降到合适机场。
items.s: we have a passenger with a suspected heart attack request diversion to a suitable airport

items.en: A pregnant passenger is in severe pain. Request priority landing and ambulance on arrival.
items.cn: 一名孕妇正承受剧痛。请示优先着陆和救护车到场。
items.s: a pregnant passenger is in severe pain request priority landing and ambulance on arrival

items.en: There was a fight onboard among a few passengers. One of them is now bleeding seriously.Request police and ambulances on arrival.
items.cn: 几名旅客在机上打架。其中一个人现在流血严重。请求警察和救护车到场。
items.s: there was a fight onboard among a few passengers one of them is now bleeding seriously.request police and ambulances on arrival

items.en: The purser told me the injured passenger has blood type O. Maybe this information is useful to the paramedics.
items.cn: 乘务长告诉我受伤旅客的血型是O型，或许该信息对急救医护人员有用。
items.s: the purser told me the injured passenger has blood type o maybe this information is useful to the paramedics

items.en: We have an 8-month old infant with head injuries. Request ambulance on arrival.
items.cn: 我们有个8个月大的婴儿头部受伤。请示救护车到场。
items.s: we have an 8 month old infant with head injuries request ambulance on arrival

items.en: A passenger is unconscious after suffering from seizure. The cabin crew is giving her first aid. We will advise if we require a diversion.
items.cn: 一名旅客癫痫发作后失去知觉。客舱机组正在急救。如需备降我们将告知你们。
items.s: a passenger is unconscious after suffering from seizure the cabin crew is giving her first aid we will advise if we require a diversion

items.en: Many passengers and crew were injured due severe turbulence. We will advise the number and severity of injuries when able.
items.cn: 由于严重颠簸，多名旅客和机组都受伤了。如能够，我们将告知受伤人数及受伤程度。
items.s: many passengers and crew were injured due severe turbulence we will advise the number and severity of injuries when able

items.en: An elderly passenger has passed away. We will continue to our destination. Request ambulance on arrival.
items.cn: 一位年长的旅客去世了。我们将继续到目的地。请示救护车到场。
items.s: an elderly passenger has passed away we will continue to our destination request ambulance on arrival

items.en: We found a passenger unconscious from a drug overdose in the lavatory. Request police and ambulance on arrival.
items.cn: 我们发现一名旅客在洗手间服药过量失去意识了。请示警察和救护车到场。
items.s: we found a passenger unconscious from a drug overdose in the lavatory request police and ambulance on arrival

items.en: The sick passenger's condition has improved. We no longer require the diversion. Request to continue to our destination.
items.cn: 生病旅客的情况已经好转。我们不再要求备降。请示继续飞往目的地。
items.s: the sick passengers condition has improved we no longer require the diversion request to continue to our destination

items.en: We received an emergency call from the cabin, but now nobody is responding. We can hear shouting and disturbance. Our cabin crew might be under duress.
items.cn: 我们收到客舱紧急呼叫，但现在没人回应。我们能听见喊叫声和打斗声。客舱机组可能受到了胁迫。
items.s: we received an emergency call from the cabin but now nobody is responding we can hear shouting and disturbance our cabin crew might be under duress

items.en: We have a hijack situation on board. Can our destination airport provide armed intervention?
items.cn: 我们被劫机了。目的地机场能否提供武装干涉？
items.s: we have a hijack situation on board can our destination airport provide armed intervention

items.en: We can see two masked men with sharp weapons on our cockpit door surveillance camera.They are kicking the cockpit door.
items.cn: 我们通过驾驶舱监控摄像机看见两个头戴面具手拿利器的人。他们正在踢驾驶舱门。
items.s: we can see two masked men with sharp weapons on our cockpit door surveillance camera.they are kicking the cockpit door

items.en: I can see the area outside of the cockpit. There are two hijack suspects standing in the aisle.
items.cn: 我能看见驾驶舱外面区域。有两名劫机者正站在过道。
items.s: i can see the area outside of the cockpit there are two hijack suspects standing in the aisle

items.en: One of the terrorists is about forty-year old. He is about 180 cm tall, wearing a brown shirt and dark pants.
items.cn: 其中一名恐怖分子大约40岁，他有180厘米高，身穿棕色衬衫和深色裤子。
items.s: one of the terrorists is about forty year old he is about 180 cm tall wearing a brown shirt and dark pants

items.en: A terrorist is trying to access the cockpit. He is about 30 years old. He is wearing a hat and backpack.
items.cn: 一名恐怖分子正试图接近驾驶舱，他大约30岁，头戴一顶帽子，背有双肩包。
items.s: a terrorist is trying to access the cockpit he is about 30 years old he is wearing a hat and backpack

items.en: The purser reports there are over ten hijackers onboard. They are threatening to kill passengers if we don't fly to another destination.
items.cn: 乘务长报告机上有超过10名劫机犯，他们正威胁我们如果不飞往另一个目的地，他们要杀死乘客。
items.s: the purser reports there are over ten hijackers onboard they are threatening to kill passengers if we don't fly to another destination

items.en: Some of the hijackers are carrying sharp protruding weapons.
items.cn: 一些劫机犯拿着锋利、尖锐的武器。
items.s: some of the hijackers are carrying sharp protruding weapons

items.en: There is a stand-off in the cabin. Some of the hijackers are carrying blades.
items.cn: 客舱已陷入僵持状态。一些劫机犯拿着刀片。
items.s: there is a stand off in the cabin some of the hijackers are carrying blades

items.en: Terrorists started to injure passengers.
items.cn: 恐怖分子开始伤害旅客了。
items.s: terrorists started to injure passengers

items.en: We will remain on the runway. The hijackers have taken four hostages to the rear of the cabin.
items.cn: 我们将停留在跑道上。劫机犯已把四名人质带到了客舱后部。
items.s: we will remain on the runway the hijackers have taken four hostages to the rear of the cabin

items.en: Terrorists are threatening to start killing passengers and the crew.
items.cn: 恐怖分子威胁说他们要杀死旅客和机组了。
items.s: terrorists are threatening to start killing passengers and the crew

items.en: The air marshal and passengers have restrained five suspects. The situation is now under control.
items.cn: 安全员和乘客已经制服了5名疑犯。局面得到了控制。
items.s: the air marshal and passengers have restrained five suspects the situation is now under control

items.en: A suspicious suitcase was found during the cabin inspection.
items.cn: 客舱检查中发现了可疑手提箱。
items.s: a suspicious suitcase was found during the cabin inspection

items.en: The air marshal is searching the aircraft interior for any suspicious articles.
items.cn: 安全员正在搜查飞机里的任何可疑物品。
items.s: the air marshal is searching the aircraft interior for any suspicious articles

items.en: Some explosives were discovered behind a panel near the back of the cabin.
items.cn: 客舱后部的一个面板后面发现一些爆炸物。
items.s: some explosives were discovered behind a panel near the back of the cabin

items.en: What do the bomb-disposal experts suggest we do?
items.cn: 拆弹专家建议我们做什么？
items.s: what do the bomb disposal experts suggest we do

items.en: The cabin crew reports a passenger is behaving strangely.
items.cn: 客舱机组报告说一名旅客行为怪异。
items.s: the cabin crew reports a passenger is behaving strangely

items.en: A bomb has exploded and the cabin is full of smoke. Request emergency descent.
items.cn: 炸弹已爆炸，客舱到处是烟雾。请示紧急下降。
items.s: a bomb has exploded and the cabin is full of smoke request emergency descent

items.en: We are evacuating on the runway. Be advised the bomb is still on board.
items.cn: 我们正在跑道上紧急撤离。被告知炸弹仍在飞机上。
items.s: we are evacuating on the runway be advised the bomb is still on board

items.en: We are unsure of our position due to navigation failure. If any station can hear me, please respond.
items.cn: 由于导航失效，我们不确定位置。如果任何电台能听到我们，请回话。
items.s: we are unsure of our position due to navigation failure if any station can hear me please respond

items.en: We only have standby magnetic compass due instrument failure. Now heading 245. Request navigation assistance.
items.cn: 我们因仪表失效只有备用磁罗盘。现在航向245，请示导航援助。
items.s: we only have standby magnetic compass due instrument failure now heading 245 request navigation assistance

items.en: We are unsure of our position due FMS failure. Last known position five miles north of FUPAD, now heading 165 for weather avoidance.
items.cn: 由于飞行管理系统失效，我们不确定当前位置。最后已知位置是PUPAD以北5海里，当前航向165以避开天气。
items.s: we are unsure of our position due f m s failure last known position five miles north of f u p a d now heading 165 for weather avoidance

items.en: We have navigation map drift. Request climb to MEA.
items.cn: 导航地图漂移，请示上升到最低航路高度。
items.s: we have navigation map drift request climb to m e a

items.en: Our cargo manifest shows that there are 80 kilograms of lithium batteries on board.
items.cn: 我们的货物舱单表明机上有80千克的锂电池。
items.s: our cargo manifest shows that there are 80 kilograms of lithium batteries on board

items.en: A ramp inspection discovered crates of lithium batteries in the cargo hold. We are verifying. Request delay pushback.
items.cn: 机坪检查发现货舱有数箱锂电池，我们正在核实。请示延迟推出。
items.s: a ramp inspection discovered crates of lithium batteries in the cargo hold we are verifying request delay pushback

items.en: We had a smoke warning in the cargo hold. We have discharged the fire extinguisher. We are concerned about lithium batteries in that compartment.
items.cn: 我们的货舱有烟雾警告，已经释放灭火瓶。我们担心货舱的锂电池。
items.s: we had a smoke warning in the cargo hold we have discharged the fire extinguisher we are concerned about lithium batteries in that compartment

items.en: The cabin crew have used up all the portable extinguishers. Request diversion.
items.cn: 客舱机组已用完了手提灭火瓶。请示备降。
items.s: the cabin crew have used up all the portable extinguishers request diversion

items.en: Request passenger stairs connect immediately after we stop on the runway. We want to disembark passengers as quickly as possible.
items.cn: 我们停止在跑道上后请示立即连接客梯车。我们想尽快让旅客离机。
items.s: request passenger stairs connect immediately after we stop on the runway we want to disembark passengers as quickly as possible

items.en: We almost had a mid-air collision with another aircraft.
items.cn: 我们差一点与另一架飞机空中相撞。
items.s: we almost had a mid air collision with another aircraft

items.en: The conflicting traffic is military. Request avoiding action.
items.cn: 冲突飞机是军用机，请示避让措施。
items.s: the conflicting traffic is military request avoiding action

items.en: Does the flight path of the unknown aircraft converge with ours?
items.cn: 不明飞机的飞行路线和我们的会聚吗？
items.s: does the flight path of the unknown aircraft converge with ours

items.en: The conflicting traffic is gray, possibly a military aircraft.
items.cn: 冲突飞机是灰色的，可能是军用机。
items.s: the conflicting traffic is gray possibly a military aircraft

items.en: We have traffic indication at 2 o'clock, 300 feet above our level.
items.cn: 冲突飞机显示在2点钟方位，高于我们300英尺。
items.s: we have traffic indication at 2 o'clock 300 feet above our level

items.en: We have a possible traffic conflict at 10 o'clock, converging with our flight path.
items.cn: 我们在10点钟方位可能有冲突飞机，该机与我们的飞行路线会聚。
items.s: we have a possible traffic conflict at 10 o'clock converging with our flight path

items.en: We have a possible traffic conflict ahead. Request radar vectors for avoidance.
items.cn: 我们前方可能有冲突飞机，请示雷达引导避让。
items.s: we have a possible traffic conflict ahead request radar vectors for avoidance

items.en: Request right turn for traffic avoidance.
items.cn: 请示右转避让冲突飞机。
items.s: request right turn for traffic avoidance

items.en: Unable to comply, TCAS RA.
items.cn: 不能照办，遵守TCASRA通告
items.s: unable to comply t c a s ra

items.en: We nearly collided with that aircraft. We had very little vertical separation. Do you know the flight number of that aircraft?
items.cn: 我们几乎与那架飞机相撞，我们之间几乎没有垂直间隔。你们知道那架飞机的航班号吗？
items.s: we nearly collided with that aircraft we had very little vertical separation do you know the flight number of that aircraft

items.en: Clear of conflict, request further instructions.
items.cn: 冲突解除，请示进一步指令。
items.s: clear of conflict request further instructions

items.en: We have injuries resulting from our TCAS maneuver. Request ambulance on arrival.
items.cn: TCAS机动导致部分旅客受伤。请示救护车到场。
items.s: we have injuries resulting from our t c a s maneuver request ambulance on arrival

items.en: Some of the cabin crew are injured. They were serving meals during the TCAS maneuver.
items.cn: 部分客舱机组受伤了。TCAS机动时他们正在供餐。
items.s: some of the cabin crew are injured they were serving meals during the t c a s maneuver

items.en: Some passengers were injured because their seatbelts weren't fastened.
items.cn: 一些旅客受伤是因为他们没有系安全带。
items.s: some passengers were injured because their seatbelts weren't fastened

items.en: Some passengers have been scalded by hot drinks.
items.cn: 一些乘客被热饮烫伤了。
items.s: some passengers have been scalded by hot drinks

items.en: We have about thirty injured persons on board, four are very serious. Can you deliver this message to the medical staff that are standing by?
items.cn: 我们机上有三十人受伤，其中4让人受伤严重。你能把此消息告知待命的医务人员吗？
items.s: we have about thirty injured persons on board four are very serious can you deliver this message to the medical staff that are standing by

items.en: We overran the runway end. We are evacuating. Request emergency services.
items.cn: 我们冲出了跑道头，正在撤离。请示紧急服务。
items.s: we overran the runway end we are evacuating request emergency services

items.en: We veered off the runway. We are evacuating near the runway and rapid exit J5.
items.cn: 我们偏出了跑道，正在撤离。我们的位置在跑道和快速脱离道口J5附近。
items.s: we veered off the runway we are evacuating near the runway and rapid exit j5

items.en: We will reach our minimum fuel if we are delayed any further.
items.cn: 如果进一步延误，我们将达到最低燃油量。
items.s: we will reach our minimum fuel if we are delayed any further

items.en: We are declaring minimum fuel. We will have less than 30 minutes endurance by the time we get to our destination.
items.cn: 我们宣布最低燃油量。，我们到达目的地机场后将有少于30分钟的续航时间。
items.s: we are declaring minimum fuel we will have less than 30 minutes endurance by the time we get to our destination

items.en: We are declaring fuel emergency. Our endurance is 1 hour 58 minutes. We are 1 hour 30 minutes from the closest alternate airport.
items.cn: 我们宣布燃油紧急状况。我们的续航时间是1小时58分钟，而我们到最近备降场的时间是1小时30分钟。
items.s: we are declaring fuel emergency our endurance is 1 hour 58 minutes we are 1 hour 30 minutes from the closest alternate airport

items.en: We are declaring fuel emergency. Request priority landing Runway 03R.
items.cn: 我们宣布燃油紧急状况。请示优先着陆，跑道03右。
items.s: we are declaring fuel emergency request priority landing runway 03 right

items.en: We have been intercepted by a military aircraft. It is rocking its wings to indicate we should follow.
items.cn: 我们被一架军用机拦截了，它摇动机翼让我们跟着。
items.s: we have been intercepted by a military aircraft it is rocking its wings to indicate we should follow

items.en: I'm trying to identify the type and nationality of the military aircraft. So far, no response on121.5.
items.cn: 我们正试着识别军用飞机的机型和国籍。到目前为止，121.5频率仍没有回应。
items.s: i'm trying to identify the type and nationality of the military aircraft so far no response on121.5

items.en: The military aircraft is commanding us to land at the airfield below.
items.cn: 军用飞机正在命令我们在下面的机场着陆。
items.s: the military aircraft is commanding us to land at the airfield below

items.en: The military aircraft has made an abrupt maneuver indicating we may continue on this heading.
items.cn: 军用飞机已突然机动，表明我们可以继续保持此航向。
items.s: the military aircraft has made an abrupt maneuver indicating we may continue on this heading

items.en: We are being escorted towards the national boundary by two military aircraft.
items.cn: 我们正在被两架军用飞机押送到国境线。
items.s: we are being escorted towards the national boundary by two military aircraft

items.en: We are heading 085. This heading allows us to quickly exit the prohibited airspace.
items.cn: 我们当前航向085.此航向可以让我们快速离开禁飞空域。
items.s: we are heading 085 this heading allows us to quickly exit the prohibited airspace

items.en: If we continue to make orbits we will exceed our duty time limit by the time we land.
items.cn: 如果继续转圈，我们将在落地时超出执勤期限制。
items.s: if we continue to make orbits we will exceed our duty time limit by the time we land

items.en: A crew member is incapacitated. Request diversion and medical assistance.
items.cn: 一名机组成员失能。请示备降和医疗救助。
items.s: a crew member is incapacitated request diversion and medical assistance

items.en: They have revived the unconscious passenger by CPR procedure. It looks like he'll be fine.Request to cancel the diversion.
items.cn: 他们通过心肺复苏程序使失去知觉的乘客恢复了意识。他好像转好，请示取消备降。
items.s: they have revived the unconscious passenger by c p r procedure it looks like he'll be fine.request to cancel the diversion

items.en: Confirm we are being vectored to fly overhead the airport for right downwind.
items.cn: 证实我们正雷达引导通过机场上空加入右三边。
items.s: confirm we are being vectored to fly overhead the airport for right downwind

items.en: Confirm we have enough separation from preceding aircraft.
items.cn: 证实我们与前机有足够间隔。
items.s: confirm we have enough separation from preceding aircraft

items.en: Unable to expedite climb due performance.
items.cn: 由于性能，不能快速爬升。
items.s: unable to expedite climb due performance

items.en: Negative contact due visibility.
items.cn: 由于能见度，不能看见（机场或飞机等）。
items.s: negative contact due visibility

items.en: Unable, we are in IMC.
items.cn: 不能，我们在仪表天气条件。
items.s: unable we are in i m c

items.en: Unable, we are only authorized during daytime VMC.
items.cn: 不能，我们只有白天目视气象条件的资格。
items.s: unable we are only authorized during daytime v m c

items.en: Unable noise abatement due company policy.
items.cn: 由于公司政策，不能执行减噪程序。
items.s: unable noise abatement due company policy

items.en: Did the previous controller tell you about our problem during radar handoff?
items.cn: 雷达移交时前一个管制员告诉你我们的问题了吗？
items.s: did the previous controller tell you about our problem during radar handoff

items.en: Is there a frequency change at this compulsory reporting point?
items.cn: 在此强制报告点需要切换频率吗？
items.s: is there a frequency change at this compulsory reporting point

items.en: Unable speed 180 knots. We need to maintain a good speed in clean configuration due icing.
items.cn: 不能保持速度180节。由于积冰，我们需要保持光洁构型下的指定速度。
items.s: unable speed 180 knots we need to maintain a good speed in clean configuration due icing

items.en: Unable to reduce speed below mach decimal 74. You can vector us if you'd like.
items.cn: 速度不能低于马赫数0.74（点74）。如果可以，你可以雷达引导我们。
items.s: unable to reduce speed below mach decimal 74 you can vector us if you'd like

items.en: Request runway change for departure due high crosswind.
items.cn: 由于大侧风，请示更换跑道离场。
items.s: request runway change for departure due high crosswind

items.en: Request delay the approach due tail wind beyond limits.
items.cn: 由于顺风超限，请示推迟进近。
items.s: request delay the approach due tail wind beyond limits

items.en: Request holding instructions due weather near the runway threshold.
items.cn: 由于跑道入口附近天气，请示等待指令。
items.s: request holding instructions due weather near the runway threshold

items.en: Unable, an immediate right turn might not give us enough terrain clearance. Our turn radius is 4 miles at this speed.
items.cn: 不行。立即右转可能导致越障阈度不够。当前速度的转弯半径是4海里。
items.s: unable an immediate right turn might not give us enough terrain clearance our turn radius is 4 miles at this speed

items.en: Sorry, there was a problem with my audio equipment. How do you read me now?
items.cn: 抱歉，我的音频设备有问题。现在你听我几个？
items.s: sorry there was a problem with my audio equipment how do you read me now

items.en: We had to overshoot because of wake turbulence.
items.cn: 我们必须复飞的原因是尾流。
items.s: we had to overshoot because of wake turbulence

items.en: Not ready for immediate takeoff due possible wake turbulence from departing heavy aircraft.
items.cn: 没有准备好立即起飞，刚起飞的重型机可能有尾流。
items.s: not ready for immediate takeoff due possible wake turbulence from departing heavy aircraft

items.en: Unable CAT II approach due crew qualification.
items.cn: 不能II类盲降进近，机组没有资质。
items.s: unable category ii approach due crew qualification

items.en: Transmission blocked, say again.
items.cn: 干扰了，再说一遍。
items.s: transmission blocked say again

items.en: Standby, high pilot workload.
items.cn: 稍等，飞行员工作负荷大。
items.s: standby high pilot workload

items.en: Are you banning us from entry because of our airline or our aircraft type?
items.cn: 你禁止我们飞入是因为我们公司或我们的机型吗？
items.s: are you banning us from entry because of our airline or our aircraft type

items.en: Our aircraft has the required certification and is approved by your Civil Aviation Authority for scheduled flight.
items.cn: 我们的飞机有相应资质，你们民航当局也批准执行定期航班。
items.s: our aircraft has the required certification and is approved by your civil aviation authority for scheduled flight

items.en: We had to go around due to unstable approach.
items.cn: 因为不稳定进近，我们必须复飞。
items.s: we had to go around due to unstable approach
